study type: Meta-analysis (9 retrospective and randomized prospective studies)
cohort: 974 women undergoing cesarean section with impacted fetal head
finding: Reverse breech extraction during cesarean section with impacted fetal head was associated with lower rates of uncontrolled uterine incision extensions, shorter surgical times, less blood loss, and fewer complications compared to abdominovaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Reverse breech extraction is a safe delivery technique for impacted fetal head during cesarean section.
